rationale: The failed-gap thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still below both VWAP (33.75) and the 9-EMA (33.55), holding in the bottom fifth of the daily range on fading 1m volume, with no VWAP reclaim and no new catalyst, leaving 33.15 as the magnet. The recent drift sideways just under the 9-EMA and the softened risk-off tape (SPY now only -0.28%) reduce conviction slightly, but nothing has invalidated the short, and the $83 risk to the 33.80 stop is well within the remaining loss budget. A flip to long would mean buying a rejected gap against intraday structure on no meaningful reversal evidence, which does not justify the added cost.
